title: EO 14176: 80,000+ Pages Released (2025)
summary: Executive Order 14176 (Jan 23, 2025) ordered full release of JFK/RFK/MLK assassination records. On March 18, 2025 NARA released 80,000+ pages in under 24 hours — 'one of the largest single releases of records in U.S. history.' The full collection exceeds 6 million pages. As of late 2026, no official review has identified a 'smoking gun' overturning the Warren Commission's lone-gunman conclusion.
